_doc: DRAFT of data/world/maps/r1/layout.json for task T0. The lead commits the final version to `thuyvan` BEFORE T3 and T4 are dispatched; T3 (water) and T4 (terrain) both read it and neither edits it.

Units: metres. North is -Z, west is -X (the region's own WorldClock north_offset_deg is 0). A square is 832 m (bake grid 833 x 833 at 1 m, as bake_terrain.py). Columns A, B, C run west to east; rows 1-4 run north to south.

The main channel is z-monotonic (north to south through C1-C4 and out of the south edge), so Phase 3 M0 can still serve it with WorldRiver (x by z, level by z) plus per-reach flow scales. The torrent (A2 to C2) is NOT z-monotonic and exists only through WaterNetwork, from Phase 3 M1 on.
Levels and widths are first numbers for T4's recipes to confirm; if a recipe cannot meet one, T4 reports it to the lead, who edits this file (never the builder).
Names here are placeholders with status proposal (the village, its clan and the lock town wait on the owner).

channels._doc: Đá Trắng's river. Nodes north to south: x, z, half_width, level (surface), flow_scale (1 = ordinary).

steps._doc: 4 m level step at the lock; M2, WaterNetwork only. Until M2 the level eases through it like a rapid.

channels._doc: West-east torrent under Two Heights, joining the main channel in C2. WaterNetwork only (M1+).

village.name: proposal: owner names the village and its submitted clan

rope_rite_cliff._doc: the Prologue's rope crossing, on today's ledge and grip system with a scripted rope

cordon._doc: S1+: soldiers and clan watchers keep people off the still water

undercut_bank._doc: just below the reach: the bank the displaced flow undercuts (Act 1.2)

gallery_mouth._doc: old masonry in the gorge wall; closed in Book I
